package rulefixtures

import (
	"net"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_network_calls_dns_lookup_per_request_path: Layer: Network calls. Flag net.Lookup* calls in request paths without caching or resolver ownership.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func FetchRemoteData(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	host := r.URL.Query().Get("host")
	if host == "" {
		host = "api.example.com"
	}
	ips, err := net.LookupHost(host)
	if err != nil || len(ips) == 0 {
		http.Error(w, "dns resolution failed", 500)
		return
	}
	target := ips[0] + ":8080"
	conn, err := net.Dial("tcp", target)
	if err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "connection failed", 500)
		return
	}
	defer conn.Close()
	w.Write([]byte("ok"))
}
